Each entry is tied to a commit, a file, a rule type and the fingerprint (sha256, first 16 hex) of the value: another value, another file or another commit is still detected. No value is stored here. Adding an entry requires a written justification in docs/SECURITE.md. See `node scripts/scan-secrets.mjs --no-allowlist` to review everything.
